data.body: Landed as Gerrit 3493, merged fed3d35d08f. Root cause: ADR 0125 stories never covered src prose, so the re-identify warning and .opcert-key note (and 5 developer-facing docstrings/comments) still described repository-pinned keys. All 4 criteria checked on merged main: both greps print nothing; reidentification_warning names verify.trusted_opcert_keys, untrusted, verify.require_environment and foreign_key and not 'pinned'; tests/interfaces/store/test_env_identity_guard.py 18 passed. make verify green locally (21563 + 226 passed).
